# Skyline Customs

> Skyline Customs is a car shop in Chantilly, VA that installs paint protection film, ceramic coating and window tinting. It serves drivers across Northern Virginia.

## Key facts

- Address: 4215 Walney Rd Suite 1A & B, Chantilly, VA 20151
- Phone: (703) 775-4383
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 9 AM–6 PM
- Google rating: 5.0 from 140+ reviews
- Paint protection film: STEK DYNOshield, 12-year warranty
- Ceramic coating: Gtechniq
- Window tint: GeoShield Pro Nano Ceramic
- Free quotes: https://www.skylinecustomshop.com/get-a-quote

## Services

- [Paint Protection Film](https://www.skylinecustomshop.com/services/ppf): clear film that stops rock chips and scratches
- [Ceramic Coating](https://www.skylinecustomshop.com/services/ceramic-coating): a hard, glossy coating that makes washing easy
- [Window Tinting](https://www.skylinecustomshop.com/services/window-tinting): window film that blocks heat and UV
